title: Final read-only live support recon
instruction: Perform a bounded read-only support-lane readiness check. Confirm you can reason and use the approved Salesforce support tools, then query the current open support-ticket queue and return only sanitized aggregate diagnostics: authentication success or failure, query success or failure, total open count, counts by approved record-type label, configured result limit, truncation status, and whether any operational blocker remains. Do not include customer names, ticket numbers, Salesforce IDs, emails, descriptions, raw rows, credentials, or other private data. Do not mutate Salesforce, Nova SQL, Rescue, email, or any provider.
